headline: Keep gate_30
evidence: Gate 40 vs gate 30 day-7 retention difference = -0.820 pp; p=0.0016
interpretation: Randomized experiment supports a product-level decision.

headline: Top 1% has 47.10x purchase lift
evidence: Captures 47.1% of observed future purchasers at that targeting depth.
interpretation: Use as propensity ranking; it does not prove outreach causes purchases.

headline: Top 10% repeat-purchase rate = 91.1%
interpretation: Prioritizes likely repeat customers; it is not an uplift estimate.

headline: Top 10% observed treatment uplift = 0.835 pp
evidence: Equivalent to about 83.5 incremental conversions per 10,000 targeted users in the test experiment.
interpretation: Use uplift ranking when deciding who should receive an intervention.
